# Source clerk and assembler brief v01 — first used on scan018

This is a source-only support role. Root decides every ink locus. Read only the current page's supplied text packet, reader returns explicitly released by root, root's crop journal, and the source structure needed for this job. Do not open images, crop, OCR, compile, render, research, install, delegate, or perform optional mathematical or coordinate computations. An existing finite computation must be copied with its actual scope and source; do not rerun it. The independent readers' original files remain unchanged.

## Record preparation

Preserve each actual reader difference, doubt, inventory row, graphical component, literal path and report-silent TeX choice with its original identity and exact source pointer. A compact source crosswalk can reference stored original files; every source must resolve unambiguously. Keep the actual C doubt-table row identity, with compound parts separately recorded. Notation, abbreviation and slip tables retain their actual source scope. Existing manuscript source words, accents, cancellation states and graphical components remain literal.

Make every public decision's `readers` mapping contain A, B and C. A reader's absence from its difference list supplies no reading. Use that reader's actual complete TeX excerpt, scope and reference for any report-silent choice. Preserve raw reported mappings separately and state source absence only within an inspected complete source span. The public builder consumes `readers` directly.

Every root-selected S confirmation must contain `S_id` and `S_status`; the builder uses those fields to display its identity. An S confirmation whose overbar is already present in C and H has zero C/H counts. An S row's broad range supplies no unobserved local example.

Use exact builder fields: `notes` is a string; `abbreviations` entries have `form` and `expansion` (the latter remains a probable expansion in the output heading); each doubt has `location`, `reading`, `alternatives`, `confidence` and `reason`; every inventory entry has the requested CSV fields and `transcribed: yes` only for selected source content. Preserve original alternate field names as provenance when needed.

## Counting and uncertainty

Root supplies all final count and confidence choices. One physical glyph/state/graphic cluster receives its selected count once. Shared H ill-placeholders or whole drawing replacements use one explicit parent; local component rows remain visible with zero duplicate count. Keep report rows and physical count loci separate. An actual C doubt resolution counts once; retaining the existing primary qualification, adding a supported alternative to it, or retaining an explicit blank alternative alone has no C count. A new qualification of previously firm content counts once. H's same primary reading with a changed editorial uncertainty marker alone has no H count; a changed primary with H's reading as a retained alternative remains qualified. Preserve each actual C status, including mixed component outcomes.

Every emitted row uses an allowed collation kind and an explicit `marked_in_H` Boolean grounded in the relevant H source or shared placeholder parent. Context used to anchor an omitted mark belongs in provenance; the public C/H reading must describe that mark's actual presence or absence.

## Exact selected-source assembly

Follow root's selected complete graphical group, including its adjacent words, nodes, scope translations, origin, baseline and local qualification. Retain each physical stroke once. A separately selected replacement cannot duplicate an overlapping component or adjoining word. The first occurrence per page carries a recurring-symbol unsure wrapper; later occurrences retain the selected primary while their independently inspected local doubts stay in the record.

The selected draft and source map must agree byte for byte. Supply complete source blocks, literal replacements, exact final offsets and attachment pointers for decisions, inventory and doubts. Every selected literal path must be traceable. Do not claim metric or rendered validation of manual drawing approximations. Keep physical paragraph blanks outside math delimiters.

The final source review is one targeted pass over actual coverage, source identities, selected exact text/paths, public fields, physical count parents and attachments. Narrow repairs found by that pass receive bounded follow-up. Preserve the earlier audit hashes and the exact scope of each repair. Do not broaden testing once the required defect is closed.

## Root handoff

Leave `main_adjudicated` and each `main_approved` false in the draft. Give the exact frozen draft/map/record hashes, current audit hash, counts, original C outcome counts and any actual unresolved issue. All public A/B/C fields, S identities and abbreviation fields must already be complete. Root reads the final selected source and record, approves it, and runs the structural commit gate. The gate binds the selected bytes to the final page and rebuilds all cumulative outputs before the next page starts.

Current approval fields in the committed record describe the completed approval. Earlier pending flags remain only in raw draft/proposal history. No source clerk declares root approval or writes a final page commit.


## Revision v02 — first used after scan019, for scan020 source roles

The final source map includes draft_sha256_utf8 equal to its selected draft's exact UTF-8 SHA-256; retain other established final-hash fields as aliases. Record attachments consumed by approve_page.py use checks/scanNNN_final_draft.tex relative to out/, and preserve the exact correspondence to the map's workspace-relative out/checks/... path. The final approval gate changes only current selected approval fields; raw reader/proposal flags remain historical. Current original C parts retain their original pending decision_status separately when the gate writes their approved outcome status.

Distinguish root_ink_choice_applied from root_source_audit_choice_applied for S coverage and administrative conventions. Both require their exact root-journal source; a source-only row does not falsely claim an ink choice.

Prepare a brief attributed mathematical-content note from the selected text before the final source freeze. Its quotations and displayed statements have exact selected source spans, including prose adjoining a display. The page's written i.e. or analogous assertion stays attributed and unverified unless an actual check was performed. Preserve complete provenance without converting transcription or source bookkeeping into a theorem check.

Ainsi les classes de $\Pi_I^{\unsure{\circ|0}}$ sont les classes de $\Pi_J^\circ$ distinctes de $\deleted{\Pi}U_{J,i}$, et de plus les \unsure{clas.|deux} parmi
\[
U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_{\unsure{\deleted{J}i|j|i}}^+,\ U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^-
\]
qui sont non vides. Or les deux classes en question sont non vides, car \deleted{$\unsure{\Sigma_i|\Sigma_j}$} $U_{J,i}$ est un voisinage de $\deleted{\Sigma}E_{\unsure{i|j}}$, et
\[
\overline{\Sigma_i^+}\cap\deleted{\Sigma}E_i\ne\varnothing,\quad
\overline{\deleted{E}\Sigma_i^-}\cap\deleted{\Sigma}E_i\ne\varnothing.
\]
On \unsure{voit|sait} donc que le nb des classes est en \deleted{\unsure{tout|est}} $(n-1)+2=n+1=\operatorname{card} I+1$ (ce qui achève \unsure{aussi|ainsi} la \unsure{dém.|dem.} par récurrence sur le nb des classes).

\uline{Lemme} Toute classe de $\Pi_I^\circ$ est de la forme $X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in\deleted{\unsure{I}}K}(\overbrace{\Sigma_\alpha^+\cup E_\alpha}^{\inserted{\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+}})$ où $K$ est une partie \inserted{\deleted{non vide}} de $I$, et
% slanted
\reversemarginpar\margin{\makebox[\linewidth][r]{\rotatebox{19}{\shortstack[l]{$K$ est $\ne\varnothing$\\si $I\ne\varnothing$}}}}\normalmarginpar
$\forall\alpha\in K$, \deleted{on a} $\Sigma_\alpha^+\deleted{\unsure{\Rightarrow}}\in\pi_0(X\setminus E_\alpha)$, tels que $\forall\alpha,\beta\in K$, $\alpha\ne\beta$, on ait $\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+\cap\widehat{\Sigma}_\beta^+=\varnothing$ $(\Longleftrightarrow\Sigma_\alpha^+\cap\Sigma_\beta^+=\varnothing)$.

| 20 | in the parenthesis, before la | aussi | ainsi | medium | The body is reduced to a nearly straight line, followed by a distinct turn and a dotted i. | Both adverbs can link the count to the conclusion. |

\page{19}
Ainsi les classes de $\Pi_I^0$ sont les classes de $\Pi_J^0$ distinctes de
$U_{J,i}$, et de plus les deux parmi
\[
U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^+, \qquad U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^-
\]
qui sont non vides. Or les deux classes en question sont non vides, car
\struck{\ill{}} $U_{J,i}$ est un voisinage de $E_i$ et
$\overline{\Sigma_i^+}\cap E_i\neq\emptyset$,
$\overline{\Sigma_i^-}\cap E_i\neq\emptyset$. On voit donc que le nb des
classes est \struck{\ill{}}
$(n-1)+2 = n+1 = \operatorname{card}I+1$ (ce qui achève aussi la dém.\ par
récurrence sur le nb des classes).
\note{ce paragraphe prolonge le raisonnement de la page 17 ; le lemme qui
suit est celui dont les pages 18 et 20 donnent la démonstration}

\emph{Lemme} Toute classe de $\Pi_I^0$ est de la forme
\[
X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}(\Sigma_\alpha^+\cup E_\alpha)
\]
\note{au-dessus de $\Sigma_\alpha^+\cup E_\alpha$, il écrit
$\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+$}
où $K$ est une partie \add{\uncertain{non vide}} de $I$, et
$\forall\alpha\in K$, \struck{\ill{}}
$\Sigma_\alpha^+\in\pi_0(X\setminus E_\alpha)$, tels que
$\forall\alpha,\beta\in K$, $\alpha\neq\beta$, on ait

# Scan020 — reader A complete audit

Complete proposed transcription: reading.tex. Structured decisions: report.json. Image history: image_audit.json. Crop coordinates and processing: crop_manifest.json. Source-only validation: source_checks.json.

Start UTC: 2026-11-20 20:45:40 UTC, recorded before packet reading.
End UTC: 2026-11-20 21:23:22 UTC.

## Scope, sequence and counts

Read the entire assigned packet, brief v18, PREAMBLE and notation snapshot. Viewed the whole scan once for layout, half a once and half b once line by line. Viewed 14 planned local crops and one new complete attachment target. All 18 image deliveries succeeded; there were no failed unseen deliveries, no repeat views and no remaining unviewed targets. The root checkpoint hold was respected after the completed visual phase, then this same context resumed. No other reader or page was inspected.

The actual C Doubtful readings table has 11 source rows. R01 has three independently recorded physical ring occurrences, giving 13 source-doubt subloci. Two source rows are resolved, nine retained. The report has 28 records, with 10 current C difference flags and 22 H difference flags. It contains 15 remaining doubtful loci, 38 inventory entries, seven graphical groups and 13 literal draw/fill commands. Each of H's three struck ill placeholders has one physical parent count.

## Compact line-by-line audit

| Physical location | Selected reading and visual audit |
| --- | --- |
| Opening line | Ainsi les classes de Pi_I are followed by sont les. First small ring retains circle/zero, printed with the page's first qualifier. Crop01. |
| Second line | classes de Pi_J distinctes de overwritten Pi/U_{J,i},. Hooked J and dotted i are readable. The second ring independently retains circle/zero, with only circle printed under the recurrence convention. Crop02; overwritten Pi settled on half a at full-scan box 1310,164–1469,265. |
| Third line | et de plus les clas./deux. parmi. The low humps do not settle the word. The distinct terminal point is retained with both candidates. Crop03. |
| Paired display | U_{J,i} cap Sigma_{j/deleted Ji/i}^+, U_{J,i} cap Sigma_i^-. The first index is a dotted long descent with a doubled low return; j is primary. The second index's dot and lower hook stay together. The Sigma upper strokes belong to their letter heads; no additional closure stroke was inferred here. Crop04. |
| Next two prose lines | qui sont non vides. Or les deux classes en question sont non vides, car. Readable on half a, including the full stops and comma. |
| Cancelled start of voisinage line | Cancelled Sigma with j primary, i alternative. Two observed oblique cancellation runs occur once in A020-G01; the deleted annotation is invisible. H's first ill placeholder is counted once. Crop05. |
| U est un voisinage de E, et | U_{J,i} and voisinage are readable. Sigma survives beneath E; its i/j index remains doubtful. The low comma is separate and retained. Crop06. |
| Low point after voisinage | New complete target crop15 contains the complete g descender and following de. The descender closes separately to the left of the gray rounded point. A020-G02 preserves the shape under a local qualifier; role, hand and surface origin remain unestablished. The E-index target was outside crop15. |
| Two barred formulas | Both closure rules are visible. The first E carries a Sigma predecessor; the second barred Sigma carries an E predecessor; the last E carries a Sigma predecessor. First endpoint comma, second endpoint point. Crop07. Both current C and H already contain the closure bars. |
| On ... donc | sait is the selected resolved reading: low returning initial with upper hook, compressed vowel group, dotted i, tall t. Crop08. |
| Count lead-in | que le nb des classes est en, followed by cancelled tout/est. En is live. A020-G03 records the two crossing runs without an added generic visible rule; the word stays doubtful. Crop09. |
| Count and opening parenthesis | (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1 (ce qui achève. The count and lower-case card were read on half b. Achève retains its grave, made of two adjoining short fragments. The complete q descender belongs to qui and is retained through the word once. Crop10. |
| Parenthetical next line | aussi remains primary with ainsi alternative. After la, the high dark triangular point is retained once in A020-G04, with unresolved role, hand and surface origin. Crop11. |
| Same line, abbreviation onward | dém./dem. retains the unaccented alternative. The following compressed word is par primary with p as an abbreviation alternative and no endpoint point. Récurrence retains its separately observed acute. Sur and the ending le nb des classes). were read completely. Crop12 and half b. |
| Lemma heading | Lemme has one underline. Toute classe de Pi_I est de la forme is readable. The lemma ring independently retains circle/zero, with the recurring primary alone printed. Crop13. |
| Lemma formula | X setminus bigcup_{alpha in deleted I K}(Sigma_alpha^+ cup E_alpha). The old I is resolved from its upright and left-reaching top/foot. The added hatted Sigma label is present. A020-G05 preserves the main brace run and its closed left retrace beside the unchanged formula. Crop13. |
| Lemma continuation | où K est une partie, inserted and cancelled non vide, de I, et. A020-G06 contains exactly non vide and de I, plus the crossing stroke and long curved guide. Partie and et remain outside that group. Crop13. |
| Slanted margin | K est neq empty / si I neq empty, on two rising lines. Readable on half b; retained as a slanted margin note. |
| First quantified condition | forall alpha in K, cancelled on a, Sigma_alpha^+ [reworked relation] pi_0(X setminus E_alpha), tels que. On a is readable beneath its crossing. H's third ill placeholder is counted once. Crop14. |
| Relation and E state | A020-G07 prints the locally qualified observed outer curve, middle run and small right return. Complete states are deleted Rightarrow then membership, deleted single arrow then membership, or live/retraced membership. They are explicit in the TeX comment and invisible annotation, without duplicate visible operators. The later E remains primary, with a locally qualified Sigma/E predecessor state. Crop14. |
| Final condition | forall alpha,beta in K, alpha neq beta, on ait hat Sigma_alpha^+ cap hat Sigma_beta^+=empty. Both hats, both plus signs, the alpha/beta indices and endpoint empty sign were inspected on half b. |
| Last parenthesis | Longleftrightarrow Sigma_alpha^+ cap Sigma_beta^+=empty. Two-ended double-line arrow, unhatted Sigmas, plus signs, both parentheses and terminal point retained. Half b. |
| Foot | Archive 19 is retained only in its comment; hand undetermined. No date or manuscript page number is supplied. |

## Exact C source-row map

| C row | Supplied source location | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | opening and lemma | Retained at all three rings: circle primary, zero alternative. Report 01, 02, 21. |
| R02 | line 3 | Retained clas./deux.; endpoint point preserved with either. Report04. |
| R03 | first paired intersection | Retained complete states; j primary, deleted Ji and i alternatives. Report05. |
| R04 | before U est un voisinage | Retained cancelled Sigma index; j primary, i alternative. Report06. |
| R05 | voisinage de E | Retained i/j. Report08. |
| R06 | word struck at right before count | Retained tout/est; literal crossing geometry added. Report16. |
| R07 | in the parenthesis | Retained dém./dem. Report19. |
| R08 | under K, union index | Resolved old I. Report22. |
| R09 | beside membership sign before pi_0 | Retained full predecessor/live-state alternatives; literal paths locally qualified. Report26. |
| R10 | above the count | Resolved sait. Report14. |
| R11 | in the parenthesis, before la | Retained aussi/ainsi. Report17. |

The notation table and slips-kept-as-written table were read in their separate source categories. No entry from those sections was invented as an extra C doubt row.

## Graphical source boundaries

G01 contains the cancelled Sigma/index and two crossings; following U lies outside. G02 contains only the gray point. G03 contains only the cancelled tout/est and its two crossings; en and the count lie outside. G04 contains only the high triangular point. G05 contains the complete first lemma formula, its parentheses, hatted label and two brace paths. G06 contains the cancelled insertion non vide and adjoining de I, once; partie and et lie outside. G07 contains only the reworked relation paths; its complete state candidates occur in a comment and invisible annotation.

All seven groups declare local source origins, baselines and fixed rectangles. Their manually selected drawing coordinates remain distinct from observed locus boxes and node font extents. The G07 annotation node is overlay, so its invisible alternative text does not enlarge the fixed drawing bounds. No rendered or metric validation is claimed.

## S coverage and attributed mathematics

S row SA01-K81-06 spans scans015–022 and explicitly records an author who viewed no scan. It supplies proposals only. On this sheet, the two Sigma_i closure rules are visible and already present in both current witnesses. The exact Sigma_1 and U_s examples quoted in S do not occur here. The report therefore records local confirmation with zero current-witness bar corrections.

Grothendieck writes the class-count argument, the count (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1, and the lemma with its pairwise conditions. He also writes the final parenthetical equivalence between the hatted and unhatted disjointness statements. The transcription preserves these assertions; no proof check or optional mathematical computation was performed.

## Completion and limitations

Source-only checks passed: balanced braces and environments, paired math delimiters, required reading selections, crop-file existence, exact C source-row links, allowed command names, and agreement between the 13 literal path commands and the report. There was no OCR, web/research, compilation, rendering, installation, image comparison or optional geometric computation. The low-confidence words, indices, complete-state choices and graphical roles remain explicit in report.json and reading.tex. No further image target is pending.

notes.page_content: The author continues a class-count argument, then writes an underlined Lemme giving a form for classes of Pi_I with the upper round mark. The author writes the count (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1 and the parenthetical statement that this also completes the induction on the number of classes. The lemma names complements of indexed unions of Sigma_alpha-plus cup E_alpha, the membership condition in pi_0(X setminus E_alpha), and pairwise disjointness of the hatted sets. The final written double arrow relates the hatted and un-hatted disjointness expressions. These are attributed manuscript assertions; this reading establishes no proof of them.

The full image measures 1683 × 2362; each supplied half measures 1683 × 1261. Crops use full-scan upper-left coordinates directly. S row **SA01-K81-06**, item SA01-29, states **81/15–22** and explicitly records that its author viewed **no scan**. It is treated as a witness proposal. The author writes the count and the claim that the parenthesis completes an induction on the number of classes. The lemma states the complement-of-unions form, a π₀ membership condition and pairwise hatted-set disjointness, followed by a written equivalence with the un-hatted disjointness expression. These are the author's assertions. Reading them supplied no proof check, reconstructed theorem or repair. **`check_events` is empty.**

Counts and source-only validation results are recorded in `report.json`; no image remains scheduled for viewing.

End UTC: **2026-11-20 21:23:48 UTC**. The final report contains **27 local records**, of which **9 have diff_C=true** and **25 have diff_H=true**. \[
U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_{\unsure{\deleted{J}i|j|i}}^+,\ U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^-
\]
qui sont non vides. Or les deux classes en question sont non vides, car $\deleted{\Sigma_{\unsure{j|i}}}$ $U_{J,i}$ est un voisinage de $\deleted{\Sigma}E_i$, et
\[
\overline{\Sigma_i^+}\cap\deleted{\Sigma}E_i\ne\varnothing,\quad
\overline{\deleted{E}\Sigma_i^-}\cap\deleted{\Sigma}E_i\ne\varnothing.
\]
On sait donc que le nb des classes est en \deleted{\unsure{tout|est}} $(n-1)+2=n+1=\operatorname{card} I+1$ (ce qui achève \unsure{aussi|ainsi} la \unsure{dèm.|dém.|dem.} par récurrence sur le nb des classes).

# Scan020 — reader A complete audit

Complete proposed transcription: reading.tex. Structured decisions: report.json. Image history: image_audit.json. Crop coordinates and processing: crop_manifest.json. Source-only validation: source_checks.json.

Start UTC: 2026-11-20 20:45:40 UTC, recorded before packet reading.
End UTC: 2026-11-20 21:23:22 UTC.

## Scope, sequence and counts

Read the entire assigned packet, brief v18, PREAMBLE and notation snapshot. Viewed the whole scan once for layout, half a once and half b once line by line. Viewed 14 planned local crops and one new complete attachment target. All 18 image deliveries succeeded; there were no failed unseen deliveries, no repeat views and no remaining unviewed targets. The root checkpoint hold was respected after the completed visual phase, then this same context resumed. No other reader or page was inspected.

The actual C Doubtful readings table has 11 source rows. R01 has three independently recorded physical ring occurrences, giving 13 source-doubt subloci. Two source rows are resolved, nine retained. The report has 28 records, with 10 current C difference flags and 22 H difference flags. It contains 15 remaining doubtful loci, 38 inventory entries, seven graphical groups and 13 literal draw/fill commands. Each of H's three struck ill placeholders has one physical parent count.

## Compact line-by-line audit

| Physical location | Selected reading and visual audit |
| --- | --- |
| Opening line | Ainsi les classes de Pi_I are followed by sont les. First small ring retains circle/zero, printed with the page's first qualifier. Crop01. |
| Second line | classes de Pi_J distinctes de overwritten Pi/U_{J,i},. Hooked J and dotted i are readable. The second ring independently retains circle/zero, with only circle printed under the recurrence convention. Crop02; overwritten Pi settled on half a at full-scan box 1310,164–1469,265. |
| Third line | et de plus les clas./deux. parmi. The low humps do not settle the word. The distinct terminal point is retained with both candidates. Crop03. |
| Paired display | U_{J,i} cap Sigma_{j/deleted Ji/i}^+, U_{J,i} cap Sigma_i^-. The first index is a dotted long descent with a doubled low return; j is primary. The second index's dot and lower hook stay together. The Sigma upper strokes belong to their letter heads; no additional closure stroke was inferred here. Crop04. |
| Next two prose lines | qui sont non vides. Or les deux classes en question sont non vides, car. Readable on half a, including the full stops and comma. |
| Cancelled start of voisinage line | Cancelled Sigma with j primary, i alternative. Two observed oblique cancellation runs occur once in A020-G01; the deleted annotation is invisible. H's first ill placeholder is counted once. Crop05. |
| U est un voisinage de E, et | U_{J,i} and voisinage are readable. Sigma survives beneath E; its i/j index remains doubtful. The low comma is separate and retained. Crop06. |
| Low point after voisinage | New complete target crop15 contains the complete g descender and following de. The descender closes separately to the left of the gray rounded point. A020-G02 preserves the shape under a local qualifier; role, hand and surface origin remain unestablished. The E-index target was outside crop15. |
| Two barred formulas | Both closure rules are visible. The first E carries a Sigma predecessor; the second barred Sigma carries an E predecessor; the last E carries a Sigma predecessor. First endpoint comma, second endpoint point. Crop07. Both current C and H already contain the closure bars. |
| On ... donc | sait is the selected resolved reading: low returning initial with upper hook, compressed vowel group, dotted i, tall t. Crop08. |

Récurrence retains its separately observed acute. Sur and the ending le nb des classes). were read completely. Crop12 and half b. |

They are explicit in the TeX comment and invisible annotation, without duplicate visible operators. The later E remains primary, with a locally qualified Sigma/E predecessor state. Crop14. |
| Final condition | forall alpha,beta in K, alpha neq beta, on ait hat Sigma_alpha^+ cap hat Sigma_beta^+=empty. Both hats, both plus signs, the alpha/beta indices and endpoint empty sign were inspected on half b. |

value.page_content: The author continues the class-count argument: the opening identifies the classes of Pi_I using classes of Pi_J and the two written intersections. He writes that the two classes are nonempty, citing a neighbourhood of corrected E_i and the two barred nonemptiness expressions. He then writes the count (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1 and describes this as completing the induction on the number of classes. The underlined Lemme states a representation by X minus an indexed union of Sigma_alpha^+ cup E_alpha, with the added hatted-Sigma label over that group; the body gives the written membership and pairwise-disjointness clauses. The final parentheses expressly relate the hatted and ordinary pairwise-intersection expressions by a double implication. These are attributed manuscript assertions, not results checked by this reading.

The first paired Sigma index, the cancelled Sigma index, the union-index state and the reworked membership retain explicit alternatives. No calculation, proof check, geometric-extrema check or pixel comparison was performed.
value.source_administration: No cotefile command is added on scan 20. The H editorial note about adjacent pages was read as apparatus; those other pages were not opened or collated. H emphasis and our single underline agree on the word Lemme. Ordinary line-wrap/display placement and the approximate margin rotation do not create correction counts.
value.source_silent_choices: The complete source selects achève with a grave, par in full, récurrence with an acute, où with a grave, both occurrences of nb without a following point, and lowercase card. It retains the upper-display plus/minus signs, the first-intersection comma, the comma after voisinage de E_i, comma/period endpoints of the nonemptiness pair, both final hats, and the final parenthesis and period. The latter two Pi superscripts print circle while their zero alternatives remain explicit in the report. The tiny final component of la is represented through that word once, not as a second free point. The source contains no extra detached-mark path beyond the six declared guide/operator/brace/cancellation paths.

The final parentheses expressly relate the hatted and ordinary pairwise-intersection expressions by a double implication. These are attributed manuscript assertions, not results checked by this reading."
